Scroll2PDF fixture test hub

Every test page in the extension repo, grouped by the feature it exercises. Open a fixture to reproduce its scenario in the real Chrome window, then capture it with the extension (Full Page, Scrollable Area, Selected Area — or Screenshot for just what you see).

Full Page

full-page-test.html

Ordinary long page with numbered rows, side columns, and a green bottom marker. Verifies full-page stitching covers the entire document and restores the original scroll.

Open fixture
Full Page · App shell

container-scroll-test.html

Pinned app layout where an inner column scrolls instead of the window (like Discord/Slack). Verifies full-page, Selected Area, and Scrollable Area all find the inner scroller.

Open fixture
Full Page · Iframes

iframe-page-test.html

Page containing a window-scrolled iframe and an app-shell iframe with its own inner scroller. Verifies embedded content is expanded and captured, then restored.

Open fixture
Bug repro · repeated header

news-scroller-chat.html

Dark chat app whose channel header and enter-chat composer are sticky bars inside the scroller, with side gutters and a live-updating clock in the header — the exact layout that repeated both bars in every Scrollable Area frame. Verifies the header appears once at the top and the composer once at the bottom. Append ?height=14000 for a taller chat.

Open fixture
Long pages

long-page-test.html

~18 000px page that must capture completely in many frames. Append ?mode=too-long (40 000px): Full Page + image gives the friendly “page too long” error (Chrome caps a single image at 32 767px per side), while Full Page + A4 PDF paginates it into many pages automatically.

Open fixture Too-long variant
Bug repro · stopped scrolling

shrinking-page-test.html

The page collapses a 2000px block on the first scroll — the exact trigger for “the selected area stopped scrolling before capture finished”. Verifies the capture adopts the smaller height instead of stalling.

Open fixture
Bug repro · white line

stripe-seam-test.html

Full-bleed color stripes with no margins. Any seam misalignment or dropped row shows up as a bright white line; the result must be seamless at every device pixel ratio.

Open fixture

selected-area-test.html

Column layout with excluded red side content. Verifies the selection crop excludes out-of-rect content and keeps a stable crop while scrolling.

scrollable-area-test.html

Plain scrollable panel. Verifies Scrollable Area mode advances top-to-bottom and restores the original position.

Chat · prepend history

prepend-history-chat.html

Bottom-anchored chat that prepends older messages when scrolled to the top. Verifies the difficult-chat capture loads history in batches without the up-and-down scroll bounce and keeps oldest-to-newest order.

Open fixture
Chat · virtualized

virtualized-chat.html

Virtualized message list that only mounts a window of rows (like Telegram/WhatsApp). Verifies virtualization is detected and every message is captured, not just the rendered slice.

Open fixture
Chat · sticky headers

sticky-chat.html

Chat with sticky date separators. Verifies repeated sticky overlays are hidden so they do not duplicate in the stitched result.

Open fixture
Chat · seam overlap

seam-overlap-chat.html

Rows with substantial duplicate overlap between viewports. Verifies the seam trimmer removes repeated rows without cutting real content.

Open fixture
Chat · lazy media

lazy-media-chat.html

Chat where images load shortly after scrolling. Verifies the capture waits for media so results do not contain blank placeholders.

Chat · dynamic resize

dynamic-resize-chat.html

Chat that changes width/height on every scroll. Verifies the capture tolerates geometry changes without aborting.

Chat · sticky chrome

sticky-chrome-chat.html

Dark chat with a sticky channel-name header and a sticky enter-chat composer inside the scroller. Verifies the chrome appears exactly once — header at the top, composer at the true bottom — never repeated per frame.

Open fixture
Chat · recreated chrome

react-recreate-chat.html

React-style chat whose sticky header and composer are re-created on every scroll (no stable DOM attributes). Verifies the dedup survives node re-creation — the exact bug that repeated the channel header and chat box in every PDF page / long image.

Open fixture
News app · sticky chrome

news-app-chat.html

Window-scrolling news feed with a sticky “World News” tab on top and a sticky “Broadcast · enter chat” bar on the bottom. Verifies Selected Area and Full Page keep the tab once at the top and never repeat either bar per frame.

Open fixture
Chat · navigation change

navigation-change-chat.html

Chat whose conversation identity changes mid-capture. Verifies the capture aborts safely and restores the page instead of producing a mixed conversation.

Open fixture
PDF breaks

pdf-smart-break-test.html

Content designed to make PDF page breaks land in awkward places. Verifies smart page breaks avoid cutting through meaningful content.

Result page

../result/result.html

The capture result page. With a PDF it now shows an inline preview of every page (scroll to review) before downloading. With an image it shows the stitched picture.

Open result page
How to run the automated suites: node tests/run-tests.js (unit), node tests/run-stage3-browser-integration.js (full-page / selected / scrollable), node tests/run-stage5-browser-integration.js (difficult chats + PDFs), node tests/run-chrome-dedup-browser-test.js (sticky chrome appears once in Scrollable and Selected Area), node tests/run-long-page-browser-test.js (pages beyond Chrome's single-canvas limit → multi-page PDF / friendly error). Point them at a Chrome instance with S2P_ATTACH_PORT and S2P_FIXTURE_BASE.
